A_proposal_burden.cause: Model initialization mismatch. Phase-13B explicitly instantiated the Stage-4D localizer with `heatmap_resolution=128`, applying a 4x average-pooling layer to the 512x512 logits before sigmoid. Phase-14 Part 3 used the default `heatmap_resolution=512`, bypassing the pooling layer. Thresholding the raw 512x512 unpooled probability map generated different connected components and NMS suppression dynamics.
A_proposal_burden.authoritative_source: Phase-13B (4.66 mean proposals) is authoritative because it matches the exact architecture topology used during the Stage-4D training and validation search.
A_proposal_burden.action_required: Phase-14 Part-3 must instantiate the localizer with `heatmap_resolution=128`.

B_metric_space.cause: Phase-10 baseline metrics were evaluated entirely in 512x512 space (GT was downsampled to 512x512 via nearest-neighbor). Phase-14 Part-0C dictates that regional refiners must restore probabilities back to the original multi-megapixel canvas using bilinear interpolation, leading to Part-3 evaluating the global model in the original space as well. The interpolation differences alter the exact Dice and overlap ratios.
B_metric_space.authoritative_source: The Phase-14 Part-0C protocol prospectively hardcoded the 512-space Phase-10 metrics (0.652776 and 0.780822) directly into the decision gate conditions. These are the authoritative gate constants, regardless of the space in which they were computed.
B_metric_space.action_required: Do not alter the official gate constants. Compute a SUPPLEMENTAL SAME-SPACE DESCRIPTIVE CONTRASTS section using the original-canvas measurements (0.642499 and 0.794521) for scientifically sound relative comparisons during re-evaluation.
